eric.name: Eric
eric.notes: Strong cyclist, weak swimmer, rebuilding conservatively. Run about equal to Ella.

ella.name: Ella
ella.notes: Strong swimmer, runs about equal to Eric. Also racing the SLC Marathon on 2027-04-24.

Z1.name: Recovery
Z1.desc: Very easy. Could chat in full sentences. Active recovery.

Z2.name: Aerobic
Z2.desc: Comfortable and sustainable for hours. Mostly nose-breathing.

Z3.name: Sub-threshold
Z3.desc: Comfortably hard. Short sentences only. Controlled -- never all-out.

Z4.name: Threshold
Z4.desc: Hard. Used sparingly, if at all.

events.name: Marathon block begins
events.notes: Ella starts building toward the SLC Marathon. Eric shifts to swim/bike.

events.name: Marathon taper begins
events.notes: Volume drops. Trust the work already done.

events.name: SLC Marathon
events.notes: Ella's marathon. Eric on support duty.

events.name: 70.3 build begins
events.notes: Triathlon focus returns for both. Bricks and open water start.

events.name: Open water season
events.notes: Swap one pool swim for open water each week once the water is warm enough.

events.name: Heat adaptation begins
events.notes: Final 6 weeks: train in the warm part of the day when you can, hydrate deliberately.

events.name: Taper begins
events.notes: Two weeks of cutting back. Nothing to gain now.

phases.name: base
phases.focus: Six weeks of pure aerobic base and swim technique. No intensity. The goal is rhythm, not fitness.

phases.name: marathon_block
phases.focus: Ella builds toward the SLC Marathon. Eric holds run maintenance and builds swim and bike volume.

phases.name: marathon_taper_race_recovery
phases.focus: Ella tapers into the marathon, races, then recovers. Eric stays easy.

phases.name: 70.3_build
phases.focus: Triathlon focus returns. Bricks, open water, and one or two controlled threshold sessions per week.

phases.name: peak
phases.focus: Highest weeks of the season. Durability and fueling rehearsal matter more than another hard session.

phases.name: taper_2wk
phases.focus: Cut volume, keep a little sharpness. Arrive healthy.

phases.name: race_week
phases.focus: Short, easy, confident. Nothing to gain this week.
